question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Obstinate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Pliable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Obstinate"** refers to someone who is stubborn, resistant to change, or unwilling to yield. (हठी)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite everyone's advice, he remained obstinate and refused to reconsider his decision.
 
 
• **"Pliable"** means flexible, easily influenced, or open to change. It is the opposite of being obstinate. (लचीला)
 
 
• **Example:** She has a pliable nature, which makes her adaptable to different situations and people.
